sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Cell-surface expression confirmed by flow cytometry; Gi-coupling activity confirmed by NanoBiT-G protein dissociation assay (L11, PMC12205060)
sites.rationale: H4R has no endogenous signal peptide; EC1 (residues 1-15) is directly extracellular. All N-terminal tags in the ledger use exogenous signal peptides that are cleaved, placing the tag before M1 (insert_after_residue=0). L10 explicitly describes FLAG at the N-terminus of full-length H4R; L11 from the same paper confirms cell-surface expression by flow cytometry and Gi-coupling by NanoBiT assay, providing surface_and_function validation. The position is topology-derived because no residue number is named for the junction, but exactly one extracellular terminus exists on this type-I GPCR topology. Full-length human H4R subcloned with N-terminal HA signal peptide followed by FLAG-tag (DYKDDDDK) and C-terminal EGFP-His8, expressed in insect cells; the exogenous HA signal peptide is cleaved, leaving the FLAG tag displayed at the extracellular N-terminus before M1. H4R has no endogenous signal peptide, so EC1 (residues 1-15) is the extracellular N-terminus.

sources.claim: The human H 4 R gene was subcloned into a modified pFastBac vector 48 , with an N-terminal haemagglutinin signal peptide followed by the Flag-tag epitope (DYKDDDDK) and a C-terminal GS linker (15 amino acids) followed by Human Rhinovirus (HRV) 3 C protease recognition site and an EGFP-His 8 tag 50 .
One copy of BN for H1R and H3R, and two copies for H2R and H4R were fused at the N-terminus of the receptors with a TEV protease cleavage site.

literature_notes: All ledger lines reporting N-terminal tags (L1, L2, L3, L4, L6, L8, L9, L10) converge on the same position: a prepend before M1 (insert_after_residue=0), using exogenous signal peptides that are cleaved to display the tag extracellularly. H4R has no endogenous signal peptide (EC1 residues 1-15 are directly extracellular). The two sites reported here differ only in tag type (FLAG vs. BN), both at the same junction; L10+L11 provide the highest validation (surface_and_function). No ledger line reports any insertion in the extracellular loops EC2 (74-87), EC3 (154-172), or EC4 (326-341). The bRIL insertion (L1) is an ICL3 replacement (intracellular, 196-304) and not a surface site. The ICL3 truncation in L2 is likewise intracellular. C-terminal tags (L5, L7, L12) are intracellular (IC4: 362-390) and recorded in other_positions.

literature_other_positions.note: LgBiT fused at C-terminus after Q378 truncation; IC4 (362-390) is intracellular, so this is a cytoplasmic C-terminal tag, not a surface site.
LgBiT attached to the C-terminus of H4R (residue 390) as part of NanoBiT tethering system; IC4 (362-390) is intracellular.
